title: feat: implement Object Manager & Field Designer visual designers with console integration
body:
Enterprise-grade visual designers for managing object definitions and configuring fields — the core metadata platform tooling described in #1135. Fully integrated into the console application at `/system/objects`.

### New Components

- **`ObjectManager`** — CRUD on meta-object definitions using standard `ObjectGrid` for the list view and `ModalForm` for create/edit operations. Features include property editing (name, label, plural label, description, icon, group, sort order, enabled), relationship display, search/filter, system object protection, confirm dialogs for destructive actions, and read-only mode.
- **`FieldDesigner`** — Field configuration wizard using standard `ObjectGrid` for the list view with a specialized `FieldEditor` panel for advanced type-specific properties. Supports 27 field types with uniqueness, defaults, picklist options, read-only, hidden, validation rules, external ID, history tracking, indexed. Type-specific editors for lookup references, formula expressions, and select options. Field type filtering, search, system field protection, and read-only mode.

### Console Integration

- **`ObjectManagerPage`** — System admin page with URL-based routing:
  - `/system/objects` — Object list view powered by ObjectManager with ObjectGrid
  - `/system/objects/:objectName` — Object detail page showing an object properties card (API name, label, plural label, group, status, field count, relationships) with FieldDesigner embedded below as the field management section
  - Clicking an object name in the list navigates to the detail URL; back button returns to the list
  - Converts metadata objects/fields from the API into typed designer props
- **`App.tsx`** — Added lazy-loaded `ObjectManagerPage` routes for both `/system/objects` and `/system/objects/:objectName` in fallback (no-app) and app-scoped system route sections
- **`SystemHubPage`** — Added "Object Manager" card with Database icon and live object count badge
- **`AppSidebar`** — Added "Object Manager" link in the system fallback navigation

### Standard Component Reuse

Both ObjectManager and FieldDesigner are built on top of standard ObjectUI components rather than custom-built list/form rendering:
- **`ObjectGrid`** (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`) — Used for list views in both components, with `ValueDataSource` for in-memory data management
- **`ModalForm`** (`@object-ui/plugin-form`) — Used for object create/edit operations in ObjectManager (using `customFields` mode, no DataSource required)
- **`FieldEditor`** panel — Specialized editor retained for FieldDesigner only, since advanced field-type-specific editing (options editor, validation rules, conditional lookup/formula/select configuration) cannot be replaced by standard form fields

### Types (`@object-ui/types`)

`ObjectDefinition`, `ObjectDefinitionRelationship`, `ObjectManagerSchema`, `DesignerFieldType` (27 types), `DesignerFieldOption`, `DesignerValidationRule`, `DesignerFieldDefinition`, `FieldDesignerSchema`

### i18n

50 new keys per locale across all 10 locales (`objectManager` + `fieldDesigner` sections under `appDesigner`), with fallback translations in `useDesignerTranslation`.

### Test Infrastructure Fix

- Created missing `vitest.setup.ts` for plugin-designer (ResizeObserver polyfill + jest-dom)
- Added `@object-ui/i18n` alias to `vite.config.ts` — **unblocks 9 pre-existing broken test suites**
- Result: 13/13 suites passing, 242 tests (was 4/13 passing, 45 tests)

### Tests

- `ObjectManager.test.tsx` — 18 tests (rendering, CRUD via ObjectGrid+ModalForm, search, system object protection, read-only)
- `FieldDesigner.test.tsx` — 18 tests (rendering, CRUD via ObjectGrid+FieldEditor, type filter, inline editor, select options, read-only)
- `ObjectManagerPage.test.tsx` — 11 tests (list view rendering, detail view via URL routing, object properties card, field management section, back navigation, relationships display, ObjectGrid primary-field-link navigation)

```tsx
import { ObjectManager, FieldDesigner } from '@object-ui/plugin-designer';

<ObjectManager
  objects={objects}
  onObjectsChange={setObjects}
  onSelectObject={(obj) => setSelectedObject(obj)}
  showSystemObjects={true}
/>

<FieldDesigner
  objectName="accounts"
  fields={fields}
  onFieldsChange={setFields}
/>
```
